title: CityLearn v3: A Configurable Simulation and Evaluation Framework for Realistic Control Studies of Renewable Energy Communities
abstract: arXiv:2609.21570v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Renewable energy communities (RECs) coordinate buildings, photovoltaic generation, batteries, electric vehicles and flexible loads. Controller studies often simplify changing participation, equipment availability, service deadlines and data quality, so lower cost or peak demand can conceal missed services or infeasible power requests. This paper presents CityLearn v3, a configurable simulation and evaluation framework for REC control studies under these conditions. It represents changing members and assets, flexible-load deadlines, demand-response requests, local energy sharing, and data or equipment failures within one simulation environment. Building and phase power limits constrain controllable requests, while a declared timestep preserves consistent power-to-energy accounting. translated_title: CityLearn v3：一个用于可再生能源社区现实控制研究的可配置仿真与评估框架
translated_abstract: 可再生能源社区（RECs）协调建筑、光伏发电、电池、电动汽车和柔性负荷。控制器研究常常简化参与成员的变化、设备可用性、服务期限和数据质量，因此较低的成本或峰值需求可能掩盖未完成的服务或不可行的功率请求。本文提出了CityLearn v3，一个在这些现实条件下进行REC控制研究的可配置仿真与评估框架。它在同一仿真环境中表示变化的成员和资产、柔性负荷期限、需求响应请求、本地能源共享以及数据或设备故障。建筑和相位的功率限制约束可控请求，同时声明的时间步长保持一致的功率-能量核算。该框架记录控制器输入，并区分所请求的动作与实际应用于仿真设备的动作。参考控制器、服务-（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: CityLearn v3是一个可配置的仿真与评估框架，能够在统一环境中真实模拟可再生能源社区中成员与资产变化、柔性负荷期限、需求响应、本地能源共享以及数据或设备故障等现实条件，从而支持更可靠可信的控制研究。
en_tdlr: CityLearn v3 is a configurable simulation and evaluation framework that realistically captures changing members and assets, flexible-load deadlines, demand-response requests, local energy sharing, and data or equipment failures within renewable energy communities, enabling more reliable control studies.
